description: PBR maps from one albedo image: normal (OpenGL for Unity/three.js and DirectX for Unreal), 16-bit height, roughness and ambient occlusion, plus a lit preview. Part of Texture tools: Turn a picture into a game-ready material: seamless tiling without visible seams or light bands, PBR maps (normal for Unity and Unreal, height, roughness, AO) from one image, channel packing for Unreal ORM and Unity masks, and texture atlases with mip-safe gutters.
